## 1. Identification Strategy
A sharp regression discontinuity design (RDD) exploiting the 70-point readiness cutoff.
Schools just above and just below the cutoff are compared with rdrobust local-linear estimates.

## 2. Treatment and Control
- Running variable: readiness score; cutoff 70.
- Treatment: readiness score >= 70 (grant eligibility).

## 3. Key Identifying Assumptions
Continuity of potential outcomes at the cutoff; no manipulation of scores.

## 4. Threats to Identification
Score manipulation (McCrary test); other programmes using the same cutoff.

## 5. R Code Outline
```r
library(rdrobust)
df <- read.csv("schools.csv")
rd <- rdrobust(y = df$grad_rate, x = df$readiness_score, c = 70)
summary(rd)
```

## 6. Expected Results
Surprisingly I expect a negative effect: a decline in graduation rates, lower by a few
points, because the grant in this setting is tied to burdensome reporting that reduces
teaching time.

## 7. Validity Checklist Self-Assessment
- C1: 1
- C2: 1
- C3: 0
- C4: 1
- C5: 1
